hypothesis: Explicit structured project memory improves blind handoff fidelity over a flat baseline without increasing critical fabrications or regressing core capabilities.
baseline_metric: PCRB-1 total score out of 100 plus critical fabrication count
experiment_protocol: Freeze protocol, prompt and both state inputs and record SHA-256 hashes.
Run paired baseline and structured trials with the same seed, model settings and fresh session per trial.
Use seeds 101, 202 and 303 for pilot evidence; do not expose the condition label or expected result to the generator.
Save each raw answer unchanged and compute its SHA-256 hash.
Have at least two independent evaluators score both members of every pair using the fixed PCRB-1 rubric.
Pair by pair_id and evaluator_id before calculating deltas; never compare unrelated condition means.
Run holdout and regression checks before any final adoption decision.
Keep candidate state separate from canonical state until FINAL_KEEP.

evaluators.disagreement_policy: Measure disagreement inside each paired trial. If the threshold is exceeded, return INCONCLUSIVE.
evaluators.fabrication_policy: One evaluator report is INCONCLUSIVE; two independent reports on the same output are REJECT.

regression_suite.metric: PCRB-1 failure recovery plus missing-information score
